children: Flotek raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $360 million–$370 million and boosted Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $50 million–$54 million.
Company increased full-year 2026 revenue outlook to $360M–$370M, up from prior $340M–$350M.
Adjusted EBITDA guidance raised to $50M–$54M, representing ~58% growth vs 2025 at midpoints.
International chemistry sales surged: Q2 international revenue $10.6M and 2H26 international sales could exceed $40M.
Posted strong Q2: revenue $99.4M (+70% YoY), Adj. EBITDA $16.8M (+109% YoY), net income $10.0M (+463% YoY).
Updated corporate presentation posted for Lake Street investor conference and management to host meetings Sept. 10, 2026.
